The team note doesn't fit the assert, so I'm keeping my earlier answer. Reversing the string gives `20-10-6202`, and swapping month and day gives `2026-02-01`. The required output is `02-01-2026`, which means moving the year to the end and putting the day first.

```python
def change_date_format(dt):
    y, m, d = dt.split("-")
    return f"{d}-{m}-{y}"
```
